entities.name: Saint Chrysogonus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Saint Chrysogonus was an early Christian martyr. According to holy tradition, he was a knight in the Roman army. In exchange for abandoning Christianity, Roman emperor Diocletian offered him the position of prefect of a province. Chrysogonus declined the offer and was executed as part of the persecution.
